Feature: GPIO Negative-Edge Interrupt Generation and Handling
Test Description: Entry: test_case() configures IRQ and system interrupt enable, initializes pad driver, configures GPIOs for input + negative-edge detect + raw clear, then for each pin enables mask, generates a falling edge, and waits with timeout; finish(test_err). Default_IRQHandler() validates per-pin DIN low after falling edge, raw status set, group status set then cleared, clears system raw status, and acknowledges GIC; updates test_err accordingly.
Remarks: Timeout (e.g., 5000 units with periodic short waits) is used to bound wait for interrupt; edge-generation wait is armed before signal change to avoid races.
Test Steps / Procedure:
Entry and setup
1) Enter test_case(); set test_err = 0.
2) If GPIO0 defined: call GIC_EnableIRQ(87). If GPIO1 defined: call GIC_EnableIRQ(88).
3) If GPIO0 defined: WRITE MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1 with LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1_GPIO0_INTR. If GPIO1 defined: WRITE MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1 with LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1_GPIO1_INTR.
4) WRITE 0xA0243ffc with 0xffffffff to drive all high initially.

Phase 1: Configure pins for input, negedge, and clear raw
5) Initialize i = 0.
6) Loop while i < 32:
   6.1) addr1 = (MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8 + i*4).
   6.2) WRITE addr1 with ((1<<20) | (1<<18) | (1<<16)) to set input, enable negedge, and clear per-pin raw.
   6.3) wait_on(10).
   6.4) i++ and continue.

Phase 2: Per-pin interrupt exercise
7) Initialize i = 0.
8) Loop while i < 32:
   8.1) wr_val = (1u << i).
   8.2) Pre-clear group raw: WRITE MIZAR_GPIO_GPIO_INTR_RAW_STCLR1 with wr_val.
   8.3) Enable only current pin: WRITE MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_EN1 with wr_val.
   8.4) wait_on(10).
   8.5) Arm ISR wait: set int_pend = 1.
   8.6) Generate falling edge on current bit:
        - WRITE 0xA0243ffc with 0xffffffff (drive high).
        - wait_on(30).
        - WRITE 0xA0243ffc with (~wr_val) (drive low for current bit).
   8.7) Initialize timeout = 5000; Loop while (int_pend && timeout--): wait_on(10).
   8.8) If timeout == 0: print timeout error for pin (i+8), increment test_err.
   8.9) i++ and continue.

Completion
9) Call finish(test_err).

Interrupt service: Default_IRQHandler()
10) local_wr = (1u << i); set int_pend = 0.
11) Restore pad driver to all high: WRITE 0xA0243ffc with 0xffffffff.
12) raddr = (MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8 + i*4); READ rdata = read_reg(raddr).
13) If ((rdata & 0x1) != 0) then increment test_err (DIN expected 0 for falling edge).
14) If ((rdata & 0x2) != 0x0) then:
    14.1) READ rdata_grp = read_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_STS1).
    14.2) If ((rdata_grp & local_wr) == 0) then increment test_err (group bit not set).
    14.3) raddr2 = (MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8 + i*4); WRITE raddr2 with ((1<<20) | (1<<16)) to keep input and clear per-pin raw.
    14.4) WRITE MIZAR_GPIO_GPIO_INTR_RAW_STCLR1 with local_wr.
    14.5) READ rdata_grp = read_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_STS1); If (rdata_grp != 0x0) then increment test_err (group not cleared).
    14.6) If GPIO0 defined: WRITE MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1 with LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1_GPIO0_INTR; call GIC_ClearIRQ(87).
          If GPIO1 defined: WRITE MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1 with LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1_GPIO1_INTR; call GIC_ClearIRQ(88).
15) Else (raw bit not set): increment test_err.
Impacted Registers: INTR_EN1, gp0_gpio_8, GPIO_INTR_RAW_STCLR1, INTR1_INTR_EN1, INTR1_INTR_STS1, RAWSTCR1lss
Validation / Acceptance Criteria:
Pass when for each exercised GPIO (8..39):
- An interrupt is observed before timeout following a generated falling edge.
- The input bit reads low after the edge.
- The group status shows the corresponding bit set during service and clears to zero after raw clear operations.
- The system raw status for the selected GPIO block is cleared after service.
Overall pass when test_err remains zero at finish().

Default_IRQHandler() checks group status presence, clears all per-pin raw status, verifies clear, clears system raw status, re-enables group mask, and clears GIC; updates test_err as needed.
Remarks: A bounded wait with timeout is used to avoid infinite hangs; wait is armed before driving the signal edge. Volatile flag ensures ISR store is observed by the wait loop.

2) If GPIO0 defined: call GIC_EnableIRQ(87). If GPIO1 defined: call GIC_EnableIRQ(88).

Configure posedge detection and input mode
4) Initialize i = 0.
5) Loop while i < 32:
   5.1) WRITE (MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8 + i*4) with 0x00020000 to enable posedge.
